summary: Two independent, small fixes bundled together: (1) cacheClassesFilters (internal/cli/data_source.go) writes a live classes_filters response into provider_payloads family="filters", id="v1" -- classes_filters.go had no write-through cache call at all, unlike every other single-fetch command in this CLI, so `offline classes filters` was unconditionally unreachable regardless of how many live calls preceded it. (2) documentation-only: the --select flag help text (root.go) and a new context tool query_tip (tools.go) note that dotted paths (e.g. --select detail.title, --select result.segments) are required to reach fields inside offline output's wrapper shapes (detail/history on offline_workout, result on any offline command returning a caveat). Also fixed the self-contradictory "Pass page parameter" wording in context.query_tips (should say cursor, matching every declared MCP pagination param). Any future regen must keep classes_filters.go's live-branch calling cacheClassesFilters with the fixed "v1" key (this endpoint returns one global vocabulary object, not a per-id collection, so there is no natural id to key on).
reason: NEW ISSUES D and H (H a relocation of the old defect 9, this time in context.query_tips rather than tool descriptions) from a third live post-fix verification sweep. The --select dotted-path finding (labeled B in that report) turned out not to be a functional bug on investigation -- filterFields already supports dotted paths, confirmed live -- so it resolved to a documentation fix rather than a behavior change.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. New test TestClassesFiltersLiveFetchPopulatesOfflineRead drives the real `classes filters` command end-to-end against a fake server and confirms the store gets populated. Live-verified against the user's real account: a live `classes filters --browse-category cycling` call followed by `offline classes filters` now returns the full real filter vocabulary instead of "not found".
